mix.text: A plant has roots, a stem, leaves, and a flower.
Each little part has its own special power.
The roots grow deep down into the soil, holding it tight, drinking water for their toil.
Roots drink up, the stem holds strong.
Leaves catch the sun all day long.
Flowers make seeds, bright colors in the breeze.
A plant is a little factory, buzzing with the bees.
The stem stands tall, carrying water up high.
To the leaves and the flower, reaching for the sky.
Leaves use the sunlight to make a tassy treat.
And we get healthy veggies and fresh fruit to eat!
Your turn!
Shall we answer before the time runs out?
Which part grows under the soil?
The roots, the roots grow under the sun.
Which part makes food using sunlight?
Leaves, leaves make food using sunlight.
Which part holds the plant up? The chip? It holds the plant up!
Remember!
Grooves drink, the stem carries.
Leaves make food and flowers make seeds.
Carrots are roots, spinach is a leaf, mangoes have seeds underneath
Find more fun worksheets on our website or app
Bye bye
